arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-final-integration.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
echo "REA_PL_CODEX_INTEGRATION_START"
git clone -q https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/project"
cd "$tmp/project"
base="$(git rev-parse main)"
printf 'BASE_MAIN=%s\n' "$base"
test "$base" = "3ecdcd79573104c39ed644dbfd1bd57596e51d06"
git fetch -q origin pull/51/head:refs/heads/rea-audit-pr51 pull/52/head:refs/heads/rea-audit-pr52
test "$(git rev-parse rea-audit-pr51)" = "fc4a89d3b1028807d72354669d5f9706b9570a8c"
test "$(git rev-parse rea-audit-pr52)" = "aff5624746e981c47bab16facb9ddc6cde371672"
git switch -q -c rea-temporary-integration
git -c user.name="REA read-only certification" -c user.email="rea-audit@example.invalid" -c commit.gpgsign=false merge --no-ff -qm "Temporary audit PR51" rea-audit-pr51
git -c user.name="REA read-only certification" -c user.email="rea-audit@example.invalid" -c commit.gpgsign=false merge --no-ff -qm "Temporary audit PR52" rea-audit-pr52
echo "INTEGRATION_MERGE=PASS"
echo "INTEGRATION_CHANGED_FILES"
git diff --name-only "$base"...HEAD | sed -n '1,60p'
echo "INTEGRATION_DIFF_CHECK"
git diff --check "$base"...HEAD
echo "INTEGRATION_TEST_CODEX"
python3 -m unittest discover -s codex/tests -p 'test_*.py'
echo "INTEGRATION_TEST_CONTROL"
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
echo "INTEGRATION_CHECKOUT_CLEAN"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
echo "REA_INTEGRATION_PASS"
echo "VPS_SUPERVISOR_PROCESS_INSPECTION_BEGIN"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
rows=[]
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdecimal():
  continue
 try:
  raw=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0',b' ')
  if not raw: continue
  text=raw.decode('utf-8','replace').lower()
  if ('supervisor_live' in text or 'supervisor_cloud_source' in text or 'telegram_gateway' in text or 'supervisor_passive' in text):
   status=(p/'status').read_text()
   uid=next((line.split()[1] for line in status.splitlines() if line.startswith('Uid:')), '?')
   rows.append((int(p.name),uid,','.join(x for x in ('supervisor_live','supervisor_cloud_source','telegram_gateway','supervisor_passive') if x in text)))
 except (OSError, UnicodeError, PermissionError):
  continue
for pid,uid,patterns in sorted(rows):
 print('VPS_MATCH_PID=%s UID=%s TYPES=%s'%(pid,uid,patterns))
print('VPS_MATCH_COUNT=%s'%len(rows))
PY
echo "VPS_SYSTEMD_SUPERVISOR_CANDIDATES"
systemctl list-units --all --type=service --no-pager --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'supervisor|telegram|codex' | cut -c 1-150 || :
echo "VPS_SYSTEMD_TIMERS_CANDIDATES"
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'supervisor|telegram|codex' | cut -c 1-150 || :
echo "REA_PL_CODEX_AUDIT_FINISHED"
